scope: W7 N06 hover Escape/leave/reentry behavior repair
protectedVisuals: CSS/Tokens unchanged; G2 accepted source snapshot retained

red.command: pnpm exec vitest run packages/layouts/src/workspace.test.tsx --maxWorkers 1 --testNamePattern 'N06 allows one hover reentry'

rootCause: Escape sets temporary=false and suppression to the region ID before a pointer leave from that panel. The handler previously ignored every non-temporary leave, so the next entry hover was suppressed indefinitely until an extra entry leave.
fix: Permit the existing hoverLeave handler for a suppressed region as well as a temporary region. This clears only the matching suppression and retains the 240ms hover delay, no-rebound behavior and cleanup.
